text: A muscular male figure with dark skin and long black hair in a topknot. His face is broad, jaw clenched, mouth open as if roaring. He wears a simple brown loincloth and a necklace of white bone-like beads. One arm is raised high, gripping a large grey axe. The other arm extends outward. He stands against a pinkish-orange sky backdrop. No other figures are visible.
